description: This Java class 'ConfigJobParameterServiceImpl' implements service logic for managing job configuration parameters related to business steps in the Apache Fineract project. It handles retrieving, updating, and listing business step configurations for jobs, specifically for the 'LOAN' category.

classes.name: ConfigJobParameterServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class for managing configuration of job parameters related to business steps in Fineract.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes available business steps for the 'LOAN' category after bean properties are set.

methods.name: getBusinessStepConfigByJobName
methods.description: Retrieves the business step configuration data for a given job name.

methods.name: updateStepConfigByJobName
methods.description: Updates the business step configuration for a specified job, validating against available steps.

methods.name: getAvailableBusinessStepsByJobName
methods.description: Fetches the list of available business steps for a given job name.

methods.name: getAllConfiguredJobNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all job names that have configurations.
